title: A density-matrix derivation of the Hartree--Fock equations in a nonorthogonal atomic-orbital basis
summary: We present a pedagogical derivation of the Hartree--Fock equations using the second-quantization atomic-orbital density-matrix formalism developed by Kjærgaard, Jørgensen, Olsen, Coriani, and Helgaker for AO-based response theory. The purpose is to introduce an alternative derivation of the Hartree--Fock equation, showing that the standard AO Hartree--Fock stationarity condition follows naturally from the exponential parametrization of the one-particle density matrix in a nonorthogonal AO basis.
